source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_66/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "school_name"

# Operation 2: group_by Source2_66_0.school_name, aggregations avg(Source2_66_1.reading_score)

# Ensure the data types match target schema: school_name (string), reading_score (float)

result["reading_score"] = result["reading_score"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_66/target_multisource.csv"
